title: Table 2-3: Fault protection
markdown:
Table 2-3: Fault protection

| Fault Protection Item                    | UPS Motion Method                                                                                                                                                                                            |
|------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Fault of low output voltage in phase A   | switch, convert the output to bypass; after troubleshooting, press button 'FAULT CLEAR' on panel to exit the UPS from fault mode, recover the normal working status, and the load will not power down again. |
| Fault of high output voltage in phase A  | switch, convert the output to bypass; after troubleshooting, press button 'FAULT CLEAR' on panel to exit the UPS from fault mode, recover the normal working status, and the load will not power down again. |
| Fault of low output voltage in phase B   | switch, convert the output to bypass; after troubleshooting, press button 'FAULT CLEAR' on panel to exit the UPS from fault mode, recover the normal working status, and the load will not power down again. |
| Fault of high output voltage in phase B  | switch, convert the output to bypass; after troubleshooting, press button 'FAULT CLEAR' on panel to exit the UPS from fault mode, recover the normal working status, and the load will not power down again. |
| Fault of low output voltage in phase C   | switch, convert the output to bypass; after troubleshooting, press button 'FAULT CLEAR' on panel to exit the UPS from fault mode, recover the normal working status, and the load will not power down again. |
| Fault of high output voltage in phase C  | switch, convert the output to bypass; after troubleshooting, press button 'FAULT CLEAR' on panel to exit the UPS from fault mode, recover the normal working status, and the load will not power down again. |
| Fault of overvoltage of bus              | switch, convert the output to bypass; after troubleshooting, press button 'FAULT CLEAR' on panel to exit the UPS from fault mode, recover the normal working status, and the load will not power down again. |
| Fault of low voltage of bus              | switch, convert the output to bypass; after troubleshooting, press button 'FAULT CLEAR' on panel to exit the UPS from fault mode, recover the normal working status, and the load will not power down again. |
| Fault of over-temperature of radiator    | switch, convert the output to bypass; after troubleshooting, press button 'FAULT CLEAR' on panel to exit the UPS from fault mode, recover the normal working status, and the load will not power down again. |
| Fault of input soft -start               | switch, convert the output to bypass; after troubleshooting, press button 'FAULT CLEAR' on panel to exit the UPS from fault mode, recover the normal working status, and the load will not power down again. |
| Fault of rectifier                       | switch, convert the output to bypass; after troubleshooting, press button 'FAULT CLEAR' on panel to exit the UPS from fault mode, recover the normal working status, and the load will not power down again. |
| Fault of short circuit of bus            | switch, convert the output to bypass; after troubleshooting, press button 'FAULT CLEAR' on panel to exit the UPS from fault mode, recover the normal working status, and the load will not power down again. |
| Fault of fuse                            | switch, convert the output to bypass; after troubleshooting, press button 'FAULT CLEAR' on panel to exit the UPS from fault mode, recover the normal working status, and the load will not power down again. |
| Fault of over-temperature of inverter    | switch, convert the output to bypass; after troubleshooting, press button 'FAULT CLEAR' on panel to exit the UPS from fault mode, recover the normal working status, and the load will not power down again. |
| Fault of inverter IGBT over-current      | switch, convert the output to bypass; after troubleshooting, press button 'FAULT CLEAR' on panel to exit the UPS from fault mode, recover the normal working status, and the load will not power down again. |
| Fault of rectification IGBT over-current | switch, convert the output to bypass; after troubleshooting, press button 'FAULT CLEAR' on panel to exit the UPS from fault mode, recover the normal working status, and the load will not power down again. |
| Fault of inverter soft-start             | switch, convert the output to bypass; after troubleshooting, press button 'FAULT CLEAR' on panel to exit the UPS from fault mode, recover the normal working status, and the load will not power down again. |
| Fault of inverter SCR                    | switch, convert the output to bypass; after troubleshooting, press button 'FAULT CLEAR' on panel to exit the UPS from fault mode, recover the normal working status, and the load will not power down again. |
| Fault of charger                         | switch, convert the output to bypass; after troubleshooting, press button 'FAULT CLEAR' on panel to exit the UPS from fault mode, recover the normal working status, and the load will not power down again. |
| Fault of bypass SCR                      | Power off (ECO mode, output to inverter)                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Fault of bypass overload delay           | Power off                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| Fault of output short circuit            | Switch to bypass                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Fault of main power                      | Forbid to start the rectifier                                                                                                                                                                                |
| Fault of bypass                          | Forbid to switch                                                                                                                                                                                             |
